# GetPhysicsContactCount 〔BlitzLLVM〕

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Physics](Blitz3D-Physics)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GetPhysicsContactCount:Int32 world:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `world` | In | Int32 | `0` | The physics world, 0 (default) for the default world. |

**Returns:** The number of contacts.

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

How many contacts the last `PhysicsUpdate` of a world found between bodies that report them (see `PhysicsContactReport`). The list is the same on every run, in the order of the bodies, one contact for each pair.

## Differences

* The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
PhysicsUpdate
For i = 0 To GetPhysicsContactCount() - 1
	Print GetPhysicsContactEntityA(i) + " touches " + GetPhysicsContactEntityB(i)
Next
```
